# Fresh independent RCLE public-plan convergence question

I am evaluating a prospectively staged multi-agent control question and want an
independent scientific judgment from the evidence, not an endorsement of my
preferred disposition. The narrow target was whether carrying one public-state
common plan unchanged through held-out physical roster expansion and
contraction can improve service recovery without materially worsening
integrated unserved demand, relative to a competent learned controller whose
policy class strictly contains the keep-plan treatment. The host was a finite
80-sector ring with four moving service beacons, an event at tick 20, training
rosters 6 and 9, held-out rosters 5 and 10, sixteen independent roots, and
prespecified simultaneous one-sided intervals. No conclusion about commonality,
persistence, fragmentation mediation, representational necessity, general
roster transfer, or real systems was permitted.

The comparison was deliberately gate-first. A fragmented public assignment
had to establish bidirectional assay sensitivity over a coherent carry law;
then public identity-free CARRY and REPLAN scripts had to control every held-out
cell and beat independent nearest service; then a cloned-state CARRY-versus-
REPLAN fork had to show a physical assignment-hysteresis opportunity. Only
after all of those could the experiment train the keep-plan controller and the
strictly containing event-flexible controller, establish comparator competence,
and compare direct recovery time and service loss. The containing controller
could exactly reproduce the treatment by zeroing its event-update outputs, so
any treatment advantage would have been a finite-training-package result, not
a missing-behavior theorem. A same-checkpoint event clamp was reserved for
localizing an eventual advantage to execution-time rekeying versus training
geometry.

The staged implementation was written in a fresh namespace and committed
before the result. Thirteen focused tests passed before and after the run. One
frozen command ran once with four workers and exited normally after about
228.844 seconds. It completed exactly 131,072 scripted episodes and 7,340,032
physical ticks, found zero state-hash mismatches at the CARRY/REPLAN fork,
included all 32 interval tails required by the reached stage, and passed every
reported conformance check. The result file remained byte-identical through
post-run verification. The learned stage did not run because the prospective
first gate failed; this absence was required by the design rather than a
missing result.

The assay required positive simultaneous lower bounds on both churn directions
for fragmented-minus-carry recovery time after subtracting three ticks and for
fragmented-minus-carry integrated unserved demand after subtracting 0.03. On
contraction from 10 to 5, the lower bounds were 2.72145 ticks and 0.07141, so
the perturbation produced clear harm. On expansion from 5 to 10, however, the
lower bounds were -1.50652 ticks and -0.00656. Mean CARRY recovery time there
was 34.2151 and mean fragmented recovery reached the censor at 36, leaving an
observed contrast of only about 1.785 ticks; mean integrated unserved demand
rose from 0.14446 to 0.16847, about 0.0240 rather than 0.03. The literal branch
was therefore assay sensitivity not established.

Later scripted diagnostics were computed before the stop but were not allowed
to override it. Only five of twenty-four public-scaffold tails passed. In the
same-state physical fork, REPLAN-minus-CARRY lower bounds were negative on both
directions: for 5 to 10 they were -0.5971 ticks and -0.03223 service loss; for
10 to 5 they were -1.2545 ticks and -0.00233. Mean REPLAN was faster than CARRY
on both paths. Those observations align poorly with a CARRY-favoring physical
opportunity, but the registered first-match map says that downstream mechanism
claims do not become gate-qualified after assay failure. No learned keep-plan,
flexible-controller, or clamp endpoint exists.

The strongest competing interpretations appear to be these. One is that the
valid early stop is decision-relevant: active target-bound investment should be
parked because the host did not establish the physical assay needed to make a
learned comparison meaningful, while narrowing to generic finite-budget
regularization is also unsupported because no learned ordering was observed.
A second is that the result is only a host-design failure: expansion recovery
was already near the censor under coherent carry, so a genuinely new host with
prospectively certified endpoint headroom might still reveal continuity value.
A third is that the descriptive REPLAN advantage is itself evidence against
persistence; the objection is that the assay gate failed and scripted laws are
not the learned treatments. Proceeding to learning now, strengthening the
fragmentation perturbation, relaxing thresholds, extending the horizon, or
adding roots would all change the object after observing it.

Please independently decide what conclusion this evidence supports at the
stated claim ceiling. In particular, assess whether the technical observation
is scientifically valid, whether the asymmetric positive control makes the
early stop a bounded synthesis rather than an inconclusive implementation
failure, how much weight the later descriptive scaffold and CARRY/REPLAN facts
deserve, and whether the investment implication is continued target-bound
work, narrowing to a generic finite-budget regularization question, or parking
active investment. Identify the strongest contrary explanation that survives,
the most serious validity or interpretation defect if one exists, and the
smallest genuinely new prospective discriminator that could change the
decision without repairing this result. Do not infer that the keep-plan
treatment lacks value, that the flexible controller is superior, or that
commonality or persistence is unnecessary unless the evidence actually
licenses that statement.

For conceptual provenance, the only remotely reachable source authority is
the public repository `https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code.git` at
commit `2b8f1ae0ea8c514bd333c45fe11275a2fabfbb81`, especially the historical RCLE
science card and the TBCFV configuration, model, experiment, run, and analysis

finite-budget alternative, but they contain no observation for this fresh

the complete terminal and conformance facts needed for this bounded judgment
